title: Api sim command result
description: The answer of POST /api/sim/{cmd}. The backend publishes the command on the ops topic and waits a short while for the simulator's control-ack: `accepted` says the command was published, `ack` carries the acknowledgement once it arrives and stays null when it did not within the wait. A rejected command is an api-error instead.

cmd_id.description: Identifier the backend gave the published command; the same value appears in the acknowledgement.

accepted.description: True when the command was published on the ops topic.

ack.description: The simulator's acknowledgement, null while none has arrived.
